label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: Recognizable classroom with repeated desks and benches, bags, ceiling fans, side openings, and a curtained stage with a board.
Long room, longitudinal furniture rows, central aisle, side openings, overhead fans, and far-end stage preserve the main spatial relationships, despite more regular spacing.
Furniture, openings, board, and fans have broadly compatible relative sizes. Bags are somewhat oversized and benches unusually slender.
Cream upper walls, yellow lower band, brown furniture, blue and dark bags, and green stage sides retain the main color organization. Surfaces are simplified and noticeably paler.
Bright interior illumination keeps the major content legible with coherent soft shadows, although it is flatter and noisier than the reference.
Complementary views show actual furniture thickness, legs, separated bench geometry, and changing occlusion within the room.

Major elements have editable mesh descendants: Box.138 and Box.139 form desk components, Box.282 and Box.283 form seating, Box defines the floor, and Box.134 defines the board. These contain finite nonempty meshes, parent chains, and assigned materials with connected surface shaders.

dimension_scores.evidence: Main classroom identity is strong; the furniture construction, floor pattern, stage depth, and architectural detail are substantially simplified.
Desks have floor-reaching supports, but benches use two thin posts without broad feet. Board supports visibly stop above the platform, and door panels are raised above floor level.
The key palette survives, but brown furniture and yellow walls are washed out; bags and curtains have primitive silhouettes.
Heavy render grain, identical block-built furniture, oval bags, flat curtains, and uniform surfaces reduce material and structural credibility.
Room depth and the principal stage, aisle, and side-wall relationships are preserved. Furniture is more rigidly repeated and the foreground feels more open.
Most functional proportions are plausible, with deviations in the tall bags, narrow bench seats, and slender supporting elements.
Lighting is readable and broadly consistent with daytime, but weak directional contrast, pale surfaces, and pervasive noise obscure material distinctions.
Major architectural and furnishing categories are represented in substantial numbers. Detailed desk frames, shutters, stage folds, and tabletop belongings are reduced or omitted.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
